title: S02T01 - Define evidence trust levels and attestation schemas
description: Model agent-reported, Boreal-witnessed, human-attested, and external-CI evidence with explicit provenance, freshness, signer, subject, and environment semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Published schemas distinguish trust level, producer, witness, timestamps, subject revision, environment, command, output hashes, and external attestation identity.
Legacy evidence imports remain readable without being silently upgraded to a stronger trust level.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
